text: One for the tracker: What is the site for the store whose appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift at Marrow Agrisupply? I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the store is Pine Crossing.

Priyanka raised it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. The morning receiver there said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver who turned up at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store's login.

I also told him two things I couldn't find: whether the problem was ever fixed, and a site code or address for Pine Crossing. Neither is in any channel or file he can see.
